selection: largest complete first-packet compositions with 2..4096 rows; deterministic cell tie break

registry.scope: Only existing artifact filenames in artifacts/v03_causal_rank_20261123, artifacts/v1_rust_whole_20261116, artifacts/v1_v03_workspace_20261117 and targeted reference matches in tools/research were inspected.
registry.reason: Head artifact contains numeric tag and offset but no routes/tag-to-class/path registry. No matching static/route/registry/payload artifact path was located within this bounded read. This is not a claim of global absence.

join_contract.required_existing_payload: Source-bound tag-index -> (class-index,path-index), path-index -> complete ordered cell-index list, plus registry binding to the checkpoint/model identity.
join_contract.destination_key: path[offset+1] if in range, otherwise None
join_contract.note: All rows in one captured head have the same current cell and one common target. Including the current path cell in the suffix instead of taking path[offset+1:] leaves within-head group cardinalities unchanged when the source suffix-validity invariant holds.

registry.minimal_future_input: Provide an already saved source-bound registry payload path, or a small exact export containing class and full residual path for the union of sampled tags; obtaining that export is outside this bounded read.

derived_observation.statement: For each of these three individual heads, endpoint-conditioned class/suffix group count equals the unconditioned class/suffix group count, because there is exactly one endpoint bit pair within that head. Both absolute group counts remain UNMEASURED without the registry.
derived_observation.no_extrapolation: The deterministic largest-first-packet sample is not random. No whole-live-state or city-wide support compression ratio is inferred.
